title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 19.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed an authenticated user to hide changes from reviewers in merge request diffs due to improper handling of file names. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
